activation_and_normalization.rationale: PyTorch module defaults provide a deterministic, widely used interpretation where the paper omits these values.

initialization_and_bias.rationale: The paper specifies layer topology but not parameter initialization or bias policy.

triplet_mining.rationale: The strict inequality and squared L2 margin follow IV-A and Equation (1). The exhaustive aggregation is an unpublished reconstruction choice, not a uniquely specified author miner. V7 preserves V6 mining to isolate stable distance and source selection repairs; this objective still admits a shrinking-scale direction.

learning_rate_grid.rationale: This discrete decade grid operationalizes the paper's stated 1e-2 to 1e-6 search range.

learning_rate_selection.rationale: The paper specifies a decreasing-loss search but omits its duration and tie-break. V7 ranks eligible probes by a fixed source training-pool identity diagnostic, then mean loss and LR. This avoids ranking exclusively by a shrinking strict-hard objective. It is not an independent validation score or an author-verified rule.

value.frame_partition: seeded affine permutation of every physical record frame before the paper's 75/25 role split; calibration remains the first 10% of the logical training partition
value.frame_order: per-device deterministic affine permutation of logical training positions; at most three of 117187 source frames are omitted per device per epoch to preserve batch_size=64
value.distance_precision: float64 calibration and grouping; direct non-MM Euclidean scoring

official_lora_runner.rationale: The paper fixes 10 known devices, batch size, hard-negative mining and the best epoch, but does not identify device IDs, the physical 75/25 frame selection, batch class composition, sample order or the exact best-checkpoint criterion.
